evidence_scope: Only two STEP exports were supplied. This is a snapshot comparison, not an intermediate edit history.
matching_rule: Exact case-sensitive PRODUCT name family after removing terminal :occurrence and vNUMBER; entity #IDs are never matched across files.
caveats: Added/removed families are unmatched labels, not proof a physical component was added/removed; a rename can appear as one of each.
Version tokens are labels, not validated source-control revisions.
Entity counts describe export structure and may change with exporter versions; they do not alone prove a geometric change.
Quantity counts are product/assembly-edge records, not expanded leaf-part quantities.
No mass, volume, bounding-box or geometric equivalence claim is made.
